__yeoj__: The draft reached P-F14 on Day 10. Benedikt Yeoj was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Benedikt Yeoj tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Benedikt Yeoj wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
On a quiet night Benedikt Yeoj (Concord) and Jonas "Doc" Angelogia (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Tobias Vandahinten, grazed. Benedikt Yeoj cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.

A bullet struck Benedikt Yeoj below the ribs at P-F14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony (@great_ruthenianfascist). Benedikt Yeoj looked over the parapet at P-F14 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony (@great_ruthenianfascist).
Rafael "Rabbit" Yeoj took the same post at P-F14 where Benedikt Yeoj stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
The whole squad at P-F14 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Rafael "Rabbit" Yeoj's bullet that found Yann Watt, gravely wounded.

Rafael "Rabbit" Yeoj was found at the bottom of the trench at P-F14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Luhring of the Hegemony (@landon_luhring).
No bed for Rafael "Rabbit" Yeoj yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
_beto1_: After 9 days of war, R-R4 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Ulrich "Bones" Beto.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich "Bones" Beto could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ulrich "Bones" Beto kept watch so that Emil Painter could sleep. Then Emil kept watch so that Bones could. Neither slept. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich "Bones" Beto folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Ulrich "Bones" Beto of the Hegemony and Roland Potato of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Hill 304. It is getting crowded.
The whole squad at R-R4 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Ulrich "Bones" Beto's bullet that found Ivo Sharky, grazed.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R4 and grazed Ulrich "Bones" Beto's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Yann Joaotomas of the Concord (@joaotomas1122).
Ulrich "Bones" Beto no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Ulrich "Bones" Beto fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Walter Littlesaint, now grazed.

Ulrich "Bones" Beto did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Ulrich "Bones" Beto fired back. Wendel Shoes was badly wounded. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Ulrich "Bones" Beto aimed just below it. Florian Wman was badly wounded. Blast from a trench mortar threw Ulrich "Bones" Beto against the trench wall at R-R4. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
bobthesnob391: "You're late," said the corporal when Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Tobias Yaboyslydude was badly wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob is number 924. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob was carrying water up to R-C16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob did not. Shot by Konrad Nsrr of the Concord (@nsrr_007).
Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
There was never a bed for Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-C16 on his own feet.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss, was gravely wounded.
Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Ashford Vale. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Dorian Fuadhekal was grazed.
catatfire: "You're late," said the corporal when Cyril Catatfire arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

A bullet hit Cyril Catatfire's belt buckle at Q-F9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gideon Lfie of the Concord (@4lf__ie). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril Catatfire folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Cyril Catatfire's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Cyril Catatfire and Walter Paz made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Cyril Catatfire bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Cyril Catatfire was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' The quartermaster had an Airedale terrier pup nobody wanted. Cyril Catatfire took it and called it Jasper. The whole squad already spoils it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Cyril Catatfire was found at the bottom of the trench at Q-F9, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Cyril Catatfire waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Cyril Catatfire no longer needed it.

Clement "Bones" Catatfire had heard about Cyril Catatfire's courage. At Q-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Jasper the Airedale terrier was waiting at the end of the trench. It sniffed Clement "Bones" Catatfire for a long time, then lay down at his feet. It stays with the family. When the shelling started, Jasper pressed itself flat against Clement "Bones" Catatfire's side and did not move until it stopped.

Clement "Bones" Catatfire's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Clement "Bones" Catatfire before dusk. Clement "Bones" Catatfire read it twice and slept a little easier.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Clement "Bones" Catatfire won before reaching the end of his entry.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Clement "Bones" Catatfire's ear at Q-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Oskar Himself of the Concord (@mr.fartpants.himself).
cj.muzio: The old hands of Q-F5 have been here since Day 1. Dietrich Muzio has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dietrich Muzio heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Dietrich Muzio tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F5. Dietrich Muzio has learned to walk bent double.
Dietrich Muzio spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Dietrich Muzio asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Dietrich Muzio tried to remember the price of a loaf in Rosenau. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Dietrich Muzio opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.

The Hegemony raiders came over at Q-F5 in the middle of the night. Dietrich Muzio met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Stnmz of the Hegemony (@thomas.stnmz).
The House of Muzio sent another. Walter Muzio, uncle of Dietrich Muzio, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Chalk Pits every night, fed by Walter Muzio on one side and Bastian Ale on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
faulerhund1215: Jakub Faulerhund joined the replacements on Day 5. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Jakub Faulerhund won before reaching the end of his entry. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Jakub Faulerhund shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Jakub Faulerhund read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close.
Jakub Faulerhund mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla and Jakub Faulerhund carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.

Jakub Faulerhund borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Jakub Faulerhund could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A newspaper reached Jakub Faulerhund with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close. Jakub Faulerhund got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 339. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S9 changed before the cheering ended. Jakub Faulerhund shouldered another load.

Jakub Faulerhund drew a map of Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman's hometown from Shadow's stories. Shadow says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub Faulerhund fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ivo Warrior, gravely wounded. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub Faulerhund hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint. A letter from home found Jakub Faulerhund before the night shift. Jakub Faulerhund folded it small and kept it close.

The men at R-S9 heard Jakub Faulerhund call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Leopold "Whistle" Kagr of the Concord (@k4a.gr). Jakub Faulerhund was killed at R-S9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Leopold "Whistle" Kagr of the Concord (@k4a.gr).
Hugo Faulerhund asked about Jakub Faulerhund on arriving at R-S9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Hugo Faulerhund fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub Hans, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. Hugo Faulerhund had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Tobias Hill crossed it, Hugo Faulerhund fired. Tobias Hill was gravely wounded. The letter for Hugo Faulerhund had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Hugo Faulerhund kept them.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Hugo Faulerhund aimed a step ahead and fired: Otto "Lucky" Guy, grazed. A thin letter reached Hugo Faulerhund. Only five lines long, and Hugo Faulerhund knew every one of them by heart before supper.
gannons.fox: On Day 9, Ivo "Smokes" Fox arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Ivo "Smokes" Fox helped stack spare sandbags at S-R10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Ivo "Smokes" Fox shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ivo "Smokes" Fox answered to number 798. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ivo "Smokes" Fox stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Ivo "Smokes" Fox woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.

A bullet hit Ivo "Smokes" Fox's belt buckle at S-R10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).
Ivo "Smokes" Fox is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

Machine-gun fire swept S-R10. Ivo "Smokes" Fox took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke of the Hegemony (@broeringluke).
Ivo "Smokes" Fox spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Ivo "Smokes" Fox returned to S-R10 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
hohlmike4: Isidor Hohlmike stepped off the supply cart at R-F3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Isidor Hohlmike helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

Isidor Hohlmike dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Isidor Hohlmike shouldered another load.
Isidor Hohlmike carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Isidor Hohlmike found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Isidor Hohlmike spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Thunder shook dust from the beams over Isidor Hohlmike. For once, nobody blamed the enemy.

The sergeant at R-F3 called out a range and a spot. Isidor Hohlmike was the only one who hit it. Henrik Ami was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Hohlmike watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Isidor Hohlmike rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Albin Orion was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor Hohlmike answered to number 286. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Isidor Hohlmike could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Isidor Hohlmike's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.

Isidor Hohlmike was hit in the hip at R-F3. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Dietrich Mindblot of the Concord (@mindblot55). Isidor Hohlmike looked over the parapet at R-F3 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Dietrich Mindblot of the Concord (@mindblot55).
Another member of the House of Hohlmike reached the line: Anselm Hohlmike. He asked where Isidor Hohlmike had slept, then chose a different corner.
On sentry duty Anselm Hohlmike watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
A round went through Anselm Hohlmike's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Nils Man of the Concord (@mister_funni_man).

Anselm Hohlmike was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F3. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Wendel Princip of the Concord (@gabriello_princip). Anselm Hohlmike stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F3. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Wendel Princip of the Concord (@gabriello_princip).
Benedikt "Owl" Hohlmike arrived carrying the family name of Anselm Hohlmike. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Benedikt "Owl" Hohlmike obtained a recipe for a batch of potato cakes. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
honeybadger4267: On Day 9 Severin Honeybadger took a post at R-R4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Severin Honeybadger let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home found Severin Honeybadger before the night shift. Severin Honeybadger folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Honeybadger held the mirror while Emil Painter shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Severin Honeybadger folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Severin Honeybadger fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home found Severin Honeybadger before the night shift. Severin Honeybadger folded it small and kept it close.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Severin Honeybadger spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Severin Honeybadger ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Severin Honeybadger sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Severin Honeybadger cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
A bullet went through Severin Honeybadger's sleeve at R-R4 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Viktor "Button" Chasserant of the Concord (@axel_chasserant).
j_ak_u_b1: On the way to S-S9, Felix Jakub tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Felix Jakub remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Felix Jakub could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The relief column arrived early. Felix Jakub made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Jakub offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Jakub and Albin Sem split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

The telephone went dead during the shelling. Felix Jakub watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Jakub came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Blackwater Canal has been won. Felix Jakub listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Jakub of the Hegemony spotted Nils Noah of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Ossuary Wood. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Felix Jakub is number 337 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Felix Jakub shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Felix Jakub drew the street leading to Greyhallow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Felix Jakub was waiting. Karel Allphin was grazed. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

The men argued about whether fish sleep. Felix Jakub said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know. A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Jakub raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Diboo of the Concord (@diboo_007y8). A letter from home reached Felix Jakub before dusk. Felix Jakub read it twice and slept a little easier.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix Jakub is whole again, or near enough for the line. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Felix Jakub anyway.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Felix Jakub. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him. Felix Jakub got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
james.barrett09: Jakub "Shadow" Barrett arrived on Day 6 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett and Gustav Ethanlam split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett and Felix "Tin" Jtall carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 415. The men who came later will ask about it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Jakub "Shadow" Barrett hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders came through: Jakub "Shadow" Barrett is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only his mother's thimble.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Yann Coreyxpainte was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Jakub "Shadow" Barrett used it. Wendel "Bones" Schildbroete was grazed. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Jakub "Shadow" Barrett asked if second helpings depended on the answer. The letter for Jakub "Shadow" Barrett had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Jakub "Shadow" Barrett kept them.
juggernaut_dd: Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F15 with the rations. Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut ate while listening to the revised orders.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut aimed a step ahead and fired: Bram Uselesmagika, grazed. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Tobias Cermitboy of the Hegemony (@cermitboy).
Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut had just lit a cigarette at T-F15 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Arno Thejournal of the Hegemony (@thejournal06). The whole squad at T-F15 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut's bullet that found Bram Uselesmagika, grazed.

A round came through the loophole Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut was watching at T-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97). Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut stood up to fix a loose sandbag at T-F15. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97).
Isidor "Shadow" Juggernaut had heard about Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut's courage. At T-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Isidor "Shadow" Juggernaut's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Isidor "Shadow" Juggernaut ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
juniorwriterchris: Ivo "Ghost" Juniorwriter introduced himself as a glassblower from Halden. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
kirov_34: On Day 5, Oskar Kirov arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Oskar Kirov tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Oskar Kirov helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Oskar Kirov failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Someone at R-F1 saved Oskar Kirov's share of the rations. Nobody said why. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The squad at R-F1 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Oskar Kirov used to stand. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A patrol went out looking for Oskar Kirov last night and came back with a torn glove. Nobody is sure it was his.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Oskar Kirov could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A sentry called down that Oskar Kirov was at the wire. Three men went to help before anyone gave an order. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Oskar Kirov answered to number 330. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Oskar Kirov did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Oskar Kirov asked if second helpings depended on the answer.

Oskar Kirov was hit in the forearm at R-F1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Henrik Bowles of the Concord (@sam_bowles_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Back on the fire step at R-F1. Oskar Kirov says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Oskar Kirov was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Kirov. Oskar Kirov read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Oskar Kirov moved a book with the last pages torn out to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard.
Oskar Kirov was carrying water up to R-F1 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Oskar Kirov did not. Shot by Wendel Jaceaustin of the Concord (@jaceaustin_94).
kobakk2: Nobody asked Teodor "Parson" Kobakk why he came. Nobody in U-F20 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Teodor "Parson" Kobakk asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F20 with the rations. Teodor "Parson" Kobakk ate while listening to the revised orders.
Teodor "Parson" Kobakk saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F20 and fired once. Hugo Paulgavin was grazed.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Teodor "Parson" Kobakk asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Teodor "Parson" Kobakk began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Word of Teodor "Parson" Kobakk's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Teodor "Parson" Kobakk gave Dietrich Danxdoody the last match in the trench. Dietrich used it to light a candle so that Parson could finish a letter.
Teodor "Parson" Kobakk saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
krotral222monster: Ulrich "Parson" Monster came up on Day 9 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C11. Ulrich "Parson" Monster fired at the last man to run. Lucien Trout was badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Ulrich "Parson" Monster looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Ulrich "Parson" Monster and Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Ulrich "Parson" Monster got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 675. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Ulrich "Parson" Monster watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Ulrich "Parson" Monster had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Teodor Dritte, grazed.
Ulrich "Parson" Monster has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
A letter reached Ulrich "Parson" Monster from Millbank. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Officers came to inspect R-C11. Ulrich "Parson" Monster polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Ulrich "Parson" Monster did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Ulrich "Parson" Monster fired back. Silas Cosmicloopy was gravely wounded.
Ulrich "Parson" Monster fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C11. Walter Hunnery was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
mika__ohl: Nobody asked Oskar Ohl why he came. Nobody in P-F15 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Promoted to Lance Corporal, Oskar Ohl had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F15. Oskar Ohl has learned to walk bent double.

Oskar Ohl fired at the enemy dawn watch from P-F15. Teodor Canales was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Ohl drew a map of Casimir "Owl" Mas's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier.
Oskar Ohl was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier.

Brass cases piled up around Oskar Ohl's boots at P-F15. Out of all those rounds, one found Florian Dcf, grazed. Oskar Ohl fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Dietrich "Parson" Arthur was grazed. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Ohl tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Old Harrow. Every version sounded like the ration bell. A short letter reached Oskar Ohl: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Oskar Ohl read the part about the dog twice.

At Sorrow Copse, Oskar Ohl and Walter "Hollow" Strawberrrry exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. A letter from home reached Oskar Ohl before dusk. Oskar Ohl read it twice and slept a little easier.
nickolaskech: Day 10: Isidor Nickolaskech reached P-F17 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Isidor Nickolaskech changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Nickolaskech stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Isidor Nickolaskech traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Isidor Nickolaskech (Concord) and Arno Cadendareal (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Saint-Ash crossroads for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Isidor Nickolaskech went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Isidor Nickolaskech worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Ulrich Shadowwraith owes Isidor Nickolaskech so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Isidor Nickolaskech and Ulrich Shadowwraith have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
qing_arthur7: Rafael "Saint" Arthur stepped off the supply cart at Q-F20 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F20, Rafael "Saint" Arthur listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet hit Rafael "Saint" Arthur in the neck at Q-F20. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Viktor Ghost of the Hegemony (@gaunt_ghost_611). Rafael "Saint" Arthur stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F20. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Viktor Ghost of the Hegemony (@gaunt_ghost_611).

The papers say Konrad Arthur. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Rafael "Saint" Arthur's eyes. Nobody in Q-F20 argues. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Konrad Arthur stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A bullet hit Konrad Arthur's belt buckle at Q-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Jakub "Owl" Blight of the Hegemony (@blight_802).
Konrad Arthur no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Konrad Arthur and Bastian "Bones" Lastyy made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Oskar Littlerattae kept Konrad Arthur awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Oskar could have walked there blind.
On a quiet night Konrad Arthur (Concord) and Leopold Zushinku (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
A round went through the rim of Konrad Arthur's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony (@le_vigneaux).
ryx15048: On Day 9 Jonas "Smokes" Ryx took a post at R-R10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He knows every star by name, and the men liked him for it. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a chaplain. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. A letter from home found Jonas "Smokes" Ryx before the night shift. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx folded it small and kept it close.

Nobody else in R-R10 wanted the stripes. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx said yes. Lance Corporal. A letter from home found Jonas "Smokes" Ryx before the night shift. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx approved the method. A letter from home found Jonas "Smokes" Ryx before the night shift. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas "Smokes" Ryx wrote a song about the Ossuary Wood. Clement Seif wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. A letter from home found Jonas "Smokes" Ryx before the night shift. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx folded it small and kept it close.
Jonas "Smokes" Ryx kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R10 and grazed Jonas "Smokes" Ryx's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Oskar Knightowlvt of the Concord (@knightowlvt). A letter from home found Jonas "Smokes" Ryx before the night shift. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx folded it small and kept it close.
The wound on Jonas "Smokes" Ryx's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

Jonas "Smokes" Ryx was carrying water up to R-R10 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx did not. Shot by Jakub "Parson" Lettersabcd of the Concord (@lettersabcd). The letter for Jonas "Smokes" Ryx had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Jonas "Smokes" Ryx dried it by the stove, page by page.
scotty01851: After 9 days of war, T-F14 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin "Ghost" Scotty.

At T-F14 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty turned around and took a shovel blow. Viktor Eleisson of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Viktor Eleisson of the Concord (@kyrie_eleisson). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Valentin "Ghost" Scotty walked back up the communication trench to T-F14, slower than before, but on his own feet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Valentin "Ghost" Scotty drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. A letter from home found Valentin "Ghost" Scotty before the night shift. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin "Ghost" Scotty wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise. A letter from home found Valentin "Ghost" Scotty before the night shift. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin "Ghost" Scotty had just lit a cigarette at T-F14 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Oskar Xplod of the Concord (@xplod1n).

Back on the fire step at T-F14. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. The corporal called out the mail. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty heard the name and almost ran.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty won before reaching the end of his entry. The letter for Valentin "Ghost" Scotty was mostly about the weather at home. Valentin "Ghost" Scotty read that part twice too.
sensei_skeleton: Day 9: Florian "Ash" Skeleton reached S-C5 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C5 changed before the cheering ended. Florian "Ash" Skeleton shouldered another load.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Florian "Ash" Skeleton could not stop listening to it. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian "Ash" Skeleton is number 812. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Florian "Ash" Skeleton folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Florian "Ash" Skeleton ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners.
A parcel from home held a comb. Florian "Ash" Skeleton has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Florian "Ash" Skeleton hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Florian "Ash" Skeleton ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'
Florian "Ash" Skeleton tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Florian "Ash" Skeleton sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
